description: This document outlines the terms and conditions of employment in accordance with the labor laws and regulations of the United Arab Emirates. It defines the rights, responsibilities, and obligations of both the employer and the employee, including job role, compensation, working hours, benefits, confidentiality, and termination conditions. This agreement serves as a legally binding contract once reviewed and signed by both parties.
